m: 1. शाचि m. pl. (perhaps connected with 2. शाक) barley or other grain which has the husk removed and is coarsely ground, VS. (Mahīdh.)
2. शाचि (prob. fr. √ शच् = शक्), and having the sense of ‘strong’ in the following compounds.
a: शाचि — a. 1 Distinguished, renowned. --2 Strong, powerful.

m: शाचि—गु mfn. (prob.) going or advancing strongly (fr., गु = ग [cf. अध्रि-गु] Sāy. ‘having strong cattle or clearly manifested rays’, fr. गु = गो), RV. viii, 17, 12.
शाचि—पूजन mfn. (prob.) having earnest worship, ib.
